header.title: Projects
header.desc: Things I've built, shipped, and learned from.

projects.title: HIMASISFO
projects.subtitle: Official Portal of the Information Systems Student Association.
projects.concept: A professional profile website and information portal designed for the Information Systems Student Association (HIMASISFO). It serves as a centralized platform to showcase student activities, share organizational news, and provide academic resources for the community.

projects.title: BehindTheWeb
projects.subtitle: Official Portal of The developer community from Code124.
projects.concept: The official profile website and digital hub for the Code124 developer community. This platform is built to highlight community initiatives, share technological insights, and foster collaboration among developers and tech enthusiasts.

projects.title: Simpul
projects.subtitle: B2B Farm E-Commerce Platform.
projects.concept: A Business-to-Business (B2B) e-commerce platform designed to shorten the supply chain by directly connecting producers with buyers. It features Group Buying to secure the best prices.

projects.title: Quest Archive
projects.subtitle: Interactive video game encyclopedia and community rating arena.
projects.concept: A digital library platform to explore thousands of games, featuring a Rate Arena for the gaming community to provide in-depth reviews across various aspects, supported by a global leaderboard.

projects.title: FreshTrack
projects.subtitle: Real-time inventory and freshness tracking system.
projects.concept: A comprehensive solution designed to monitor the lifecycle of fresh produce. It helps businesses track inventory, reduce waste, and ensure maximum freshness from farm to table.
